description: This file defines a utility class `CarHelper` for managing and validating car-related media slot reservations within an Android media browsing service. It includes methods for package validation and setting reservation flags in a Bundle.

classes.name: CarHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to validate car package names and manage slot reservation flags in media playback.

methods.name: isValidCarPackage
methods.description: Checks if the provided package name matches the expected Android auto application package.

methods.name: setSlotReservationFlags
methods.description: Sets or removes reservation flags in the provided Bundle based on boolean parameters for different media control slots.
